name: Pia Carrot Toybox
source:
Toybox is an assembly of a series of Pia Carrot-based mini games. It's a internet browser interface where you can explore various places or "virtual sites" and play games or look at CGs. 

[From [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=196&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
translation:
《Pia Carrot》系列迷你游戏合集。它采用互联网浏览器界面，玩家可探索各个地点或“虚拟站点”，游玩游戏或查看CG。

[摘自[url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=196&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
